notes.title: New Changelog
notes.content:
Thought I'd make a proper changelog for whenever we make small edits like this. If the game ever updates and you're wondering why, you can check here!

Version 3.04
[list]
[*] Removed Polish language option since it was missing translations. It'll be added back once the translations are done!
[/list]

Version 3.05
[list]
[*] Polish translations have now been added!
[/list]

Version 3.06
[list]
[*] Fixed a typo!
[/list]

Version 3.06
[list]
[*] Fixed a typo!
[/list]

Version 3.09
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where, after an update, the game would start in Japanese and muted. The game now launches in English at 50% volume if it's been updated/reinstalled.
[/list]

Version 3.10
[list]
[*]Fixed bug where characters sometimes had miscolored textboxes.
[*]Changed a couple words so they were more appropriate.
[/list]

Version 3.11
[list]
[*]Added text tags (does not affect translations).
[*]Fixed achievement bug.
[/list]

Version 3.12
[list]
[*]Added version number to options screen.
[*]Added text animations (only affects English language).
[*]Added custom cursor.
[*]Added voice bites for every character.
[*]Fixed a few spelling/grammar/punctuation errors.
[*]For those who go through code, updated the im.MatrixColor properties to work with the newest version of Renpy. Shouldn’t affect gameplay, just code!
[/list]

Version 3.14
[list]
[*]On start up the character voice volume is 50% instead of 100% to match default SFX and music volumes.
[*]Fixed a bug related to arrow hit-boxes being wonky (made the gym level inaccessible).
[/list]

notes.title: Small Update for Mobile Translations!
notes.content:
hello hello! i'm just updating the pa series on steam so the code is consistent between the games and their mobile versions, which will now be supporting all the translations the series has accumulated to date! included in this update are:
* small tweaks to button text sizes/positioning
* added translated main menu image for brazilian portuguese (currently only pa1)
* expanded the bani-regular font to include cyrillic characters
* changed button names for consistency between russian translations

in other words, most things won't affect you if you're just playing the english version on pc. that's all for this minor update, hope yall have an amazing day and thank you as always for enjoying our games!!

notes.title: Purrfect Apawcalypse 3: Now in Chinese!
notes.content: heya everyone! purrfect apawcalypse: patches' infurno (along with the rest of the series) is now available in chinese! to change the language all you gotta do is boot up the game, open the options menu and select your language! thanks so much to 荼郁 and 雾子 for their translation of the game, i hope the chinese-speaking community enjoys having the translation officially on steam. :> anyway that's all for now, thank you as always for supporting our funny lil furry games, have an awesome day!

notes.title: Small Update
notes.content:
just updated the trilogy with changes that don't really affect the player. this update just makes the code consistent with the mobile and itch versions of the game. this helps us fix bugs across the board if one crops up. thanks for playing and enjoy the steam summer sale! :>

edit: the update archived the images in the game folder by accident, they've now been unarchived for your memery! same goes for scripts now!

notes.title: "Invalid Platform" Error Fix!
notes.content:
​Hiya everyone! 

I've made a small update to the game that contains a few typo fixes and also a fix for those of you who, when launching the game on Windows OS, receive a pop up with the message "An error occurred while updating Purrfect Apawcalypse: Patches' Inferno (invalid platform)".​ If after downloading the new version of the game this pop up still occurs, you might have to manually replace the executable file yourself. [url=https://drive.google.com/file/d/1qRPpzk8qczXOCd4wsfzdxFiIkiJDNKFx/view?usp=sharing]You can find the fixed executable file here​![/url] Just drop it into the game's local files and replace the old .exe file. You can access the local files by right clicking the game in your library, clicking Manage and then Browse Local Files!

Hopefully this helps, if not please let me know! Thank you for your patience and also HAPPY PRIDE MONTH! <3
